description: This file is a PHP script for rendering the edit or create view of a module in the vtiger CRM system, handling form display, data retrieval, and validation setup.

classes.name: $focus
classes.description: An instance of the current module's class, used to retrieve and store entity data.

classes.name: $smarty
classes.description: An instance of vtigerCRM_Smarty, used for template rendering.

methods.name: retrieve_entity_info
methods.description: Retrieves entity information for a given record ID.

methods.name: getBlocks
methods.description: Fetches form blocks for display based on module and view.

methods.name: getEntityName
methods.description: Retrieves the entity name for a given module and record ID.

methods.name: updateInfo
methods.description: Provides update information for a record.

methods.name: getTabid
methods.description: Returns the tab ID for the current module.

methods.name: getDBValidationData
methods.description: Fetches validation data for fields in the module.

methods.name: split_validationdataArray
methods.description: Splits validation data into arrays for field names, types, and labels.

methods.name: vtlib_getFieldHelpInfo
methods.description: Gathers help information for fields in the module.
